notes: The Duet is a wheelchair tandem (passenger in a wheelchair in front, rider behind) made by Huka (Netherlands) and sold in the US by Mobility & Access (as 'Duet Electro' for the e-assist version). The given src is a Huka user-manual PDF that the browser can't read as text, so I used Huka's product page (hukabikes.com) as maker and Mobility & Access as the US retailer/distributor. The two disagree on the motor: Huka says optional Bafang rear-wheel motor, Mobility & Access says 250W Heinzmann with torque sensor. No class, speed, torque, range or weight in text anywhere. Recheck: Huka's 2026 Duet price list PDF (pdf.js text) gives the e-assist option as 'Bafang, incl. 750Wh accu'; Huka's technical-info and leaflet PDFs have no text layer; Mobility & Access technical data is images only. No class/speed or weight found in text.
